subject: MAP Weekly Sync — Security Closure Roadmap & Evidence Timeline
messages:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa@northwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@northwave.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Weekly: security evidence & pen-test window

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. NorthWave is trying to finalize our MAP and close before the end of the quarter. A couple of items we still need to lock down from Redwood to satisfy our internal audit and procurement:

1) SOC 2 excerpt: short list of evidence artifacts we can send to our compliance team (logs, retention policy, access reviews).
2) DPA redlines: we shared a first pass; need to understand which clauses Redwood will accept vs. request for legal review.
3) Pen test: proposed scope and a preferred testing window (mid-November) so we can book internal resources.

Can you confirm owners and ETA for those three so we can finalize our risk committee memo? We're aiming to have the MAP closed by Nov 18 so procurement can process PO.

Attachments: pen-test-scope-request.pdf (proposal from NorthWave)

Best,
Lisa Hart
Head of Security Programs
NorthWave Security
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Hart <lisa@northwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Weekly: security evidence & pen-test window

Lisa —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can definitely support a Nov 18 MAP close. Below are committed owners and ETA for each ask; I've included the attachments we'll push to your drive link today.

Action summary (owners & ETA):
- SOC 2 evidence bundle (logs + retention + access review samples) — Owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2027-10-15 (initial bundle) — Attachment: SOC2-evidence-extract.pdf
- DPA redline response (highlighted accept/need-legal) — Owner: Ben Carter (contracts) — ETA: 2027-10-18 — Attachment: DPA-redlines-annotated.docx
- Pen test scope & scheduling — Owner: Rishi Malhotra (I will coordinate vendor + your security lead) — Proposed window: 2027-11-14 to 2027-11-18 — Will confirm vendor availability by 2027-10-20 — Attachment: pen-test-scope-proposal.pdf

Next steps:
1) We will upload the SOC2 bundle to the Google Drive folder you shared by EOD Friday (10/15).
2) Ben will send a redline summary email with the two clauses we expect counsel to review; if your legal wants tracked changes we can provide them.
3) Rishi to confirm preferred pen-test vendor and exact dates by 10/20; once agreed, we'll share an SOW and coordinate DocuSign for the engagement.

If you want a brief call to walk through the evidence bundle before sending to your auditors, Marissa is available Thu (10/14) 10–11am PT.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Lisa —

I'll own assembling the evidence package. Quick note on contents so your audit team knows what to expect:

Planned SOC2 evidence bundle (initial):
- System architecture diagram (redacted) — shows logging pipeline and retention points
- Sample access review export (user list, last review date)
- Retention & deletion policy excerpt (data lifecycle)
- Audit log sample (7 days, redacted identifiers)
- Pen-test summary template we provide to vendors (controls scope)

I'll upload PDFs and a short index file explaining each artifact to the Drive by EOD 10/15. If your auditors need raw logs or longer retention windows we'll route that request to infra and flag expected lead time (usually 2–3 business days).

Confirming Thu 10/14 10–11am PT works for me for a quick walkthrough. Ben — once you have the DPA summary, can you drop the key negotiation points into the Drive and copy Lisa?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Lisa —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the DPA redlines and captured the negotiation items into the attached doc (DPA-redlines-annotated.docx). Quick highlights:

- Data processing scope: we accept your baseline with one clarification on subprocessor notice timeline (we propose 30 days).
- Liability cap ask: Redwood prefers a relative cap tied to annual contract value; I'll propose language and flag for legal if needed.
- Audit clause: acceptable but we'll offer an offsite evidence review option to avoid direct access to production systems.

I'll upload the redline summary and a tracked-changes version for your counsel by 10/18 as promised. Also, I looped security@northwave.com on the SOW question so we can confirm whether their internal pen-test vendor is allowed or if they prefer Redwood's partner list.

Ben Carter
Contracts Lead, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA-redlines-annotated.docx
